newsitem.title: UK: Cedel has plans to deliver real-time settlement.
newsitem.headline: Cedel has plans to deliver real-time settlement.

text.p: Cedel Group has published a plan outlining the introduction of a real-time environment, in which transactions will be settled continuously, the international clearing and settlement organisation said in a statement on Thursday.

The publication titled "Delivering real-time settlement and enhanced custody services" outlines how between the end of 1998 and early 1999, Cedel Bank will implement the next stage of a plan to clear and settle all types of cash and securities transactions, including securities lending and borrowing and new issue distribution, on a continuous basis in real-time.
Cedel is being partnered by several leading information technology specialists the statement said, including Anderson Consulting and TIBCO.

"Our vision is to respond to our customer's demands; our vision is straight through processing in a real time environment, spanning on-line information, order routing and continuous settlement," Cedel Group chief executive officer Andre Lussi said in the statement.
